Validate Anchoring Inputs

Source: R/validate_inputs.R
validate_anchor_inputs.Rd

Standardizes the study-variable metadata shape and checks the minimum structure required by the package.

Usage

validate_anchor_inputs(
  population,
  metadata,
  concepts = NULL,
  episodes = NULL,
  anchor_col = "T0"
)

Arguments

population

A data frame containing at least person_id and the anchor column used for windowing.

metadata

A data frame in the standard study-variable format.

concepts

A concept table as a data frame, a DuckDB file path whose concept_table contains person_id, concept_id, and date, or parquet file location(s).

episodes

Optional data frame with person_id, start_episode, end_episode columns, required when metadata uses an episode-based constructor. See R/pregnancy_window.R.

anchor_col

Column to use when metadata does not specify the anchor column.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with normalized population, metadata, concepts, and episodes.
